title: UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Online Form 2026
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
vacancyDetails: Posts under UP Forensic Science Laboratory cadre as per UPSSSC advertisement
qualification: Science / Forensic Science related degree or diploma as per post in official advt
ageLimit: As per UPSSSC rules for the advertisement
selectionProcess: Written Exam / PET as applicable → Document Verification
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Complete One Time Registration if required
3. Open Forensic Science Laboratory recruitment apply link
4. Fill form, upload documents, pay fee
5. Submit and print application
shortDescription: UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Online Form 2026 – apply on upsssc.gov.in as per official advertisement schedule.
content:
UPSSSC has invited / published recruitment related to Forensic Science Laboratory posts for Uttar Pradesh.

Candidates with science/forensic qualifications should read the full advertisement for post-wise eligibility, vacancies and exam scheme. Apply only through upsssc.gov.in.
